back.reason: live는 상태동사. would 반복 용법은 동작동사만 받는다. → I used to live in Paris as a child.

cards.front: Did you would go there often? — 맞나?

cards.front: 시점 표현 없이 I'd say no.라고만 하면 어떻게 들리나?

back.reason: 가정("그렇다면 난 거절할 텐데")으로 들린다. 과거 반복으로 쓰려면 시점을 먼저 깔 것 — Even as a little girl, I'd say...

cards.front: 어린 시절, 꿈을 말할 때마다 아빠가 직업으로 되돌려주던 그 장면 — 통으로 떠올려 보세요.

back.en: Even as a little girl, they wanted me to think of a future career. I'd say to my dad, "I want to be a writer." and he'd say, "journalist." I'd say I wanted to have a refuge for stray cats, and he'd say, "veterinarian." I'd say I wanted to be an actress, and he'd say, "TV newscaster." It was this constant conversion of my fanciful ambition into these practical, money-making ventures.
back.speaker: Céline
